[[File:GTA SA Robbing Uncle Sam.jpg|thumb|Help Ryder If He Needs It]]

Follow the directions to the docks, jump over the wall, and shoot the guard down. There are two strategies to follow here. You can either shoot the gate switch immediately and then assist Ryder with the guards when necessary, or you can shoot the warehouse switch first and move the crates to more convenient locations before allowing Ryder to enter. Either way, load the boxes into the truck, then hop into the driver's seat and drive like a bat out of hell to the lockup - two Patriots are after you. Tell Ryder to throw a box and blow them up if you need to. That's all for Ryder!

==Rewards==
* '''Respect''': +5
